paragraphs: This demo project showcases the tooling available in Red Hat Process Automation Manager implementing complex decision logic and process automation for a financial mortgage home loan application. The mortgage project in this demo uses technical rules, decision tables, guided rules, user tasks, task forms, and process automation to define its mortgage home loan calculations and approval system. You'll be running this demo through the process automation business central dashboard.
You can install this project on your own machine or on an OpenShift Container Platform.
